issue.positionEn: Follow clothing, sound, objects and cities to examine the conditions under which works are made, circulate and meet their publics.
issue.introEn: A painting meets a different viewing distance, a record enters a new listening setting, and a garment carries traces of making. Follow clothing, sound, objects and cities to see how works are made and how they meet their publics.
